claims.description: Open API endpoint POST openapi/v1/order-item-artworks/{order_item_artwork_id}/design replaces the printfile of an order item in place (mirrors Portal 'Replace design'): gated by ability orders:write; artwork_id/customization_id/printarea_id unchanged; target order item must be READY (status 2) else 422; 404 when the order item artwork does not exist or does not belong to the caller's account; 422 when neither file nor url is provided; Replace design only, Add new design is out of scope.
claims.reason: dev_doc: the dev's PR #3910 writeup on TIB-5506 (plus generated redoc API docs attached 2026-10-07), with locator, link, date and verbatim quote in 5.1. Author is a Dev, the submitter is QA, so they differ. The TIB-172 test cases are supporting only: no build/version was recorded (Phần 3 'không rõ build cụ thể'), so test_case does not qualify on its own. Normalizer: only the sub-claims covered by the verbatim quote are CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (ability, in-place replace with ids untouched, READY(2) precondition -> 422, 404/422 error cases, Replace-only scope). 'Input via multipart file or JSON url', '200 returns the full order-item-artwork object', 'overwrite same path / ?v= cache bust' and 'does not change fulfillment status' appear only in the Phần 1 narrative and are not quoted verbatim, so they must not be CONFIRMED_EXPECTED on this source. Everything in Phần 4.2 is excluded: app-side order status value after replace, file validation rules (incl. 900x1345 on 1400x1400), URL fetch rules/SSRF, the current 500 error-handling on bad input, file+url sent together, READY item already sent to fulfillment.

ref.quote: "Added POST openapi/v1/order-item-artworks/{order_item_artwork_id}/design, gated by the existing orders:write ability. Mirrors the Portal's "Replace design" action exactly (same upload/storage logic) — only the file changes in place, artwork_id/customization_id/printarea_id are untouched." "Scope note: this covers Replace design only, not Add new design ..." "Precondition: the target order item must currently be in READY status (value 2), or the call is rejected with a 422." "Error responses: 404 — order item artwork not found, or doesn't belong to the caller's account 422 — order item isn't in READY status (2), or neither file nor url was provided"

overall_decision: CCR_INGEST with 0 explorers. Both claims are S3 dev_doc, NOT_SHIPPED (TIB-5506 is in QA Review, live on staging, which is the teeinblue knowledge environment), and ADD to object 'order' under a new feature 'open-api-replace-order-item-design' (mint FEATURE-ID). The base order KB (KB-001, KB-014..KB-024, storefront feature) covers only portal/storefront and the internal /api/orders. It has no Open API, order-item-artwork, replace design or orders:write coverage, so there are no target_kb_ids. Phần 4.2 exclusions must stay out of CONFIRMED_EXPECTED. Phần 1-only details of CLAIM-01 that are not quoted verbatim must not become CONFIRMED_EXPECTED on this source.
